entryPoints.name: Base_Definitions
entryPoints.description: Called by the game once when the script's state is created, before main starts. Host globals such as Object and PlayerObject are set only after it returns. A pooled state that is reused does not run it again on attach: it ran when the previous instance ended. The vanilla libraries define it and call Definitions from it.

entryPoints.name: main
entryPoints.description: The script's thread. The game resumes it once per service tick; the script ends when it returns.

entryPoints.name: On_Unit_Added
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a unit is added to the free store.

entryPoints.name: On_Unit_Service
entryPoints.description: Called by the game for the free store's units at the rate set by the global UnitServiceRate.

entryPoints.name: Evaluate
entryPoints.description: Required in every evaluator script: the game refuses to load an evaluator without it. Called each time the evaluator is asked for a value; PlayerObject and Target are set before the call.

entryPoints.name: Evaluator_Clean_Up
entryPoints.description: Optional. Called by the game after Evaluate.

entryPoints.name: Story_Event_Trigger
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a story event fires for the plot. Defined by the vanilla story library.

entryPoints.name: Story_Handle_Esc
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when the player presses Escape in story mode.

entryPoints.name: Game_Mode_Starting_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a game mode starts.

entryPoints.name: Game_Mode_Ending_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a game mode ends.

entryPoints.name: Player_Quit_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a player quits.

entryPoints.name: Tactical_Unit_Destroyed_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a unit is destroyed in a tactical battle.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Unit_Destroyed_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a unit is destroyed in galactic mode.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Production_Begin_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when galactic production of an object begins.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Production_Canceled_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when galactic production of an object is canceled.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Production_End_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when galactic production of an object ends.

entryPoints.name: Tactical_Production_End_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when tactical production of an object ends.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Starbase_Level_Change
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a starbase changes level.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Planet_Faction_Change
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when a planet changes faction.

entryPoints.name: Galactic_Neutralized_Event
entryPoints.description: Called by the game when an object is neutralized in galactic mode.

entryPoints.name: Reset_Tactical_Stats
entryPoints.description: Called by the game to reset the tactical statistics.

entryPoints.name: Get_Current_Winner_By_Score
entryPoints.description: Called by the game for the player currently winning by score.

entryPoints.name: Get_Frag_Count_For_Type
entryPoints.description: Called by the game for the kill count of an object type.

entryPoints.name: Get_Neutralized_Count_For_Type
entryPoints.description: Called by the game for the neutralized count of an object type.

entryPoints.name: Get_Game_Stat_For_Control_ID
entryPoints.description: Called by the game for the statistic shown by a statistics screen control.

entryPoints.name: Update_GameSpy_Game_Stats
entryPoints.description: Called by the game before it reads the global GameSpy_Game_Stats.

entryPoints.name: Update_GameSpy_Player_Stats
entryPoints.description: Called by the game before it reads the global GameSpy_Player_Stats.

entryPoints.name: Definitions
entryPoints.description: The script's own setup. Called once by the library's Base_Definitions, if defined. Host globals are not set yet when it runs.

entryPoints.name: PG_Story_Mode_Init
entryPoints.description: Called once by the state machine's Base_Definitions after Definitions, if defined. Defined by the vanilla story library.

entryPoints.name: Pump_Service
entryPoints.description: Called by PumpEvents on every pump, if defined - once per service tick while a thread sleeps. The vanilla command library defines it and calls Story_Mode_Service from it.

entryPoints.name: Story_Mode_Service
entryPoints.description: Called on every pump by the command library's Pump_Service, if defined, whatever the state of the story events.
